title: Add auth settings and canonical env overrides
body:
## Summary
- switch settings env overrides to canonical `OS_<NAMESPACE>_<KEY>` names and document AI/auth environment variables
- add Auth settings for email/password policy and Google sign-in credentials, including encrypted Google secret storage
- wire Auth settings into the better-auth runtime config, keep admin operations always enabled, and hide incomplete 2FA UI until the full flow ships

## Verification
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs types:check`
- `pnpm test`
- Browser/API checked Auth settings fields, Google credential behavior, and login page Google button rendering
